summary: Acer Aspire 5 Gaming system experiencing Blue Screen of Death (BSOD) errors with error message "nvldddmkm.sys" when playing games. Device was previously gaming smoothly for over a year before the issue started.
detected_fault: Thermal throttling due to overheating or driver issues or outdated drivers or BIOS version issues or compatibility problems
suggested_solution: Reinstall NVIDIA GeForce RTX 2050 drivers, check for BIOS updates and install latest version if available, run stress test on device to identify potential thermal throttling issues, consider performing clean installation of Windows using bootable pendrive.
